# Hinton Evolution Tech

This file provides information for AI agents and large language models (LLMs) about Hinton Evolution Tech, a premium web design and development company based in Durgapur, West Bengal.

## About Us

Hinton Evolution Tech specializes in responsive custom web development, ecommerce, and high-converting modern websites. We deliver thoughtful UI/UX, eCommerce solutions, and professional SEO architecture.
